title: Health & SLA
subtitle: Liveness, reliability and dependencies across your estate — derived from observed activity and the staleness sweep, never by probing infrastructure.
auditedNote: The live stream and any resolve/edit action are privileged, audited operations. Health is derived; the engine never carries error text or payloads here.

stateHint.unknown: No check tracks this subject — not the same as healthy.
stateHint.observed: Seen alive by an edge, but no check is declared — health is not measured (neither healthy nor unknown).

desiredHint.paused: Not alerting — paused by an operator.

status.title: Monitored subjects
status.slaBreachHint: An SLA breach is open for this subject.

empty.title: No subjects monitored yet
empty.description: Once a health check is declared for an agent or MCP server, its liveness appears here.

checks.title: Health checks
checks.description: Declare and govern the cadence, grace window, SLA target and lifecycle intent for monitored agents and MCP servers.
checks.duplicate: A health check already exists for this subject.
checks.reportTooltip: Probe report ingestion is machine-facing and is intentionally omitted from the console.

form.name: Name
form.validation: Enter a subject reference, positive whole-number cadence and grace values, and an SLA target from 0 to 1000000.

createDialog.title: Create health check
createDialog.description: Declare one monitored agent or MCP server. A subject can have only one health check.

edit.title: Edit health check
edit.description: The subject is immutable. Update the displayed configuration and lifecycle intent.

delete.title: Delete health check
delete.description: Permanently delete the health check for {{subject}}. This admin action is recorded in the audit ledger.

empty.title: No health checks declared
empty.description: Create a check to govern the expected liveness cadence of an agent or MCP server.

sla.title: Reliability (SLA)
sla.pickEmpty: No monitored subjects to report on yet.

pickPrompt.title: Pick a subject
pickPrompt.description: Choose a monitored subject to see its uptime against target, reconstructed from the reliability ledger.

sla.degradedNote: Degraded counts as up for the SLA — shown separately, not as downtime.

noCheck.title: No check declared
noCheck.description: There is no health check for this subject, so no reliability can be reported. This is honest state, not a failure.

noData.title: No history yet
noData.description: This subject has a check but no reliability history in the window — uptime is undefined, not 0%. It appears once transitions are recorded.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.resolveHint: Resolving acknowledges the period closes — it does NOT claim the subject recovered. Recovery comes from real liveness. This action is privileged and audited.
incidents.possibleEvasionHint: A subject went silent within its expected cadence (a sweep-detected down). A subject that stops emitting is itself a signal, not a UI failure.

empty.title: No incidents
empty.description: No reliability incidents match this filter. Open incidents appear here as subjects degrade or go down.

incidents.truncatedHint: There are more incidents than shown; this page is capped, so an empty rest is NOT proof there are none.

timeline.title: Reliability timeline

pickPrompt.title: Pick a subject
pickPrompt.description: Choose a monitored subject to trace its reliability transitions from the append-only ledger.

causeHint.edge: Inferred from observed activity (a liveness edge).
causeHint.report: An active health probe reported this state.
causeHint.sweep: Detected by the staleness sweep — silence within the expected cadence.

timeline.possibleEvasionHint: A down detected by the staleness sweep means silence within the expected cadence — surfaced as possible evasion, not a load error.

empty.title: No transitions recorded
empty.description: This subject has no reliability transitions in the ledger yet.

timeline.truncatedHint: There are more events than shown. The page is ordered by id (oldest first), so what is cut off is the MOST RECENT stretch — an event you do not see here is not an event that did not happen.

deps.title: Dependency map
deps.subtitle: Auto-discovered from observed activity. Each node is colored by its current health — a node seen alive but with no check is "observed" (blue, health not measured), a node with no signal at all stays gray (unknown); neither is ever green.
deps.truncatedHint: The dependency graph has more nodes than shown; this is the first keyset page.

empty.title: No dependencies discovered yet
empty.description: Once agents call MCP servers and tools, the observed dependency graph appears here.

mobile.title: The map needs a wider screen
mobile.hint: Open this view on a larger display for the interactive dependency graph.

detail.name: Name
detail.minimalData: Only metadata is shown. By design the engine never carries error text, payloads or secrets here (minimal-data).

live.note: Rows update live as health changes; reconciled by id, not by assuming continuity.

empty.title: Nothing to show
empty.description: There is no health data for this tenant yet.

forbidden.title: Health not authorized
forbidden.description: Your role does not include permission to view health and SLA.

forbiddenResolve.title: Resolve not authorized
forbiddenResolve.description: Resolving an incident requires the check-admin permission (health:check:admin).

empty.title: No connectors configured
empty.description: Once connectors are onboarded, their operational health appears here.

emptyMode.title: No connectors match this mode
emptyMode.description: Change the mode filter to see other connectors.

statusPage.title: Olivares Control Plane — Status
statusPage.subtitle: Current operational status of all components.

update.title: Updates
update.unconfigured: Update checking is not configured. This is expected for air-gapped deployments.

system.title: System health
system.unavailable: Operational data is unavailable or not authorized.

keys.title: Key custody
keys.empty: No key custody metadata is available.

config.title: Effective configuration
config.empty: No effective configuration entries are available.

support.title: Support bundle
support.description: Generate a diagnostic archive for support without exposing stored secret values.
support.confirmDescription: This privileged AAL3 action is recorded in the audit ledger.
support.contents: The bundle contains redacted effective configuration, operational status and logs. Review it before sharing.
support.needsAal3: Hardware-backed AAL3 step-up is required to generate a support bundle.
